title: Macron's error on Hamas during UN speech sparks Israeli anger
subhead: During his speech at the United Nations podium on Tuesday, the French president claimed that Hamas had never operated in the West Bank. This factual error was immediately seized upon by Benjamin Netanyahu, who used it to deflect criticism of his settlement policy in the occupied territories.

title: Inside Pope Leo XIV's plane
subhead: Pope Leo XIV's visit to France, from September 25 to 28, marks the first official state visit by a pope in 18 years. On a specially chartered plane from Rome, he will be accompanied by 80 journalists. The trip follows a highly codified ritual, during which reporters who are practicing Catholics sometimes step outside their professional role.

title: After Céline Dion, Pope Leo drives tourism across France
subhead: From Paris to Metz, the Pope's visit to France from September 25 to 28 is expected to attract one million visitors and increase hotel bookings. However, pilgrims tend to spend less than fans of the Canadian superstar.
